name: Git Permissions
description: Grants tiered git capability (r/w/d) with an orthogonal protected-branches guardrail.

permissions.label: Git permissions (rwd)
permissions.description: Comma-separated tier letters. See the keyword table below for what each unlocks. Default 'r' matches the legacy 'read-only only' behavior.

protectedBranches.label: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Branches the agent must NOT modify. Type a branch name plus an optional description (e.g. why the branch is protected), then click Add. Delete an entry to remove its protection. An empty list means no branches are protected.
